notes: EduPage source IDs are preserved so this snapshot can be converted reproducibly into derived fixtures.
Each source card is repeated under every class affected by a cross-class lesson.
Split groups, team teaching, cross-class lessons, and multi-period lessons are preserved.
Unscheduled entries have no published day or period and are kept separately per class.
The public source also contains teacher activities without a class; those are counted in sourceCardCount but are not class schedule entries.
